stemMd: What is the complete solution set over the real numbers of $|2x+1|\leq3$?
explanationMd: Write −3≤2x+1≤3. Subtract 1 to get −4≤2x≤2, then divide by 2. The resulting closed interval is [−2,1].

distractorRationale.e: This retains only one inequality and reverses its sense.
distractorRationale.a: This describes the outside rather than the bounded interval.
